SELECT max(CASE WHEN regexp_full_match("amount", '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?$') THEN length(ltrim(split_part(ltrim("amount", '-'), '.', 1), '0')) END) AS i0, max(CASE WHEN regexp_full_match("amount", '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?$') THEN length(rtrim(split_part("amount", '.', 2), '0')) END) AS s0, count(*) FILTER (WHERE "amount" IS NOT NULL AND NOT regexp_full_match("amount", '^-?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]*)?$')) AS n0 FROM temp.main."__numeric_text_stage"
BEGIN TRANSACTION
DESCRIBE "lake"."t"
COMMIT
DROP TABLE IF EXISTS temp.main."__numeric_text_stage"
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM "lake"."t"

SELECT job_id FROM bigquery_jobs('h''q', maxResults := 1)

SELECT job_id,
             json_extract_string(configuration, '$.query.destinationTable.projectId') AS project,
             json_extract_string(configuration, '$.query.destinationTable.datasetId') AS dataset,
             json_extract_string(configuration, '$.query.destinationTable.tableId')   AS table,
             
   total_slot_time_ms,
   json_extract_string(statistics, '$.query.totalBytesProcessed') AS bytes_processed,
   json_extract_string(statistics, '$.query.totalBytesBilled')    AS bytes_billed,
   json_extract_string(statistics, '$.query.cacheHit')            AS cache_hit
      FROM (SELECT * FROM bigquery_jobs('h''q',
                                        parentJobId := 'parent-1')
            WHERE job_type = 'QUERY')
      ORDER BY creation_time DESC
BEGIN TRANSACTION
